title.en: Can Qwen normalize piles before a second DeBERTa check?
title.ru: Сможет ли Qwen нормализовать стопки перед второй проверкой DeBERTa?

hypothesis.en: A guarded DeBERTa → Qwen canonicalizer → DeBERTa sandwich can recover missed paraphrase piles without merging different meanings.
hypothesis.ru: Защищённый сэндвич DeBERTa → Qwen-нормализатор → DeBERTa сможет вернуть пропущенные стопки пересказов и не смешать разные смыслы.

qwen.system: You rewrite one pile of statements as one short atomic factual claim. Preserve every number, scope, negation, uncertainty, and condition. Add nothing. Return the claim only.

frozen_method.canonical_claim_valid: Every original statement entails the Qwen claim and the Qwen claim entails every original statement.
frozen_method.invalid_canonical_claim: Keep the original pile and do not use its Qwen claim in second-pass merging.
frozen_method.second_pass_candidate: Two valid canonical claims are compared in both directions with ordinary NLI.
frozen_method.merge_rule: Merge only when both directions are entailment.
frozen_method.final_groups: Connected components of predicted pile merge edges.

boundary.en: This is a post-hoc paired diagnostic on opened synthetic English answers. Success would justify a new held-out test; it would not validate production merging or multilingual use.
boundary.ru: Это post-hoc paired diagnostic на уже открытых синтетических английских ответах. Успех позволит поставить новый закрытый тест, но не подтвердит production-склейку или другие языки.
